narr: Residual monsoon moisture and mostly sunny conditions in the morning allowed for a few thunderstorms to form over northern Arizona.
ev: The river gauge in Granite Creek at Prescott measured a rise from 7.08 feet to 9.51 feet in about 30 minutes.
